Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks again for working with us on the customer spotlight. We're planning a short press announcement to coincide with our product update the week of March 4. Attached is a one-pager with the draft blurb and suggested talking points.

Key asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a short executive quote (1-2 sentences) that we can include in the release?
- We'd like to hold the release under embargo until 08:00 PST on March 4. Is that workable?
- We'll need permission to use the Redwood logo and a short byline crediting Redwood in the blog.

I've cc'd Ben from your team for logistics. Happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Thanks Evan — excited to partner on this. A few quick items from our side so we can finalize before the embargo:

1) Quote: Can you confirm who from ClearSky will be quoted? If Lena (CTO) or Evan (Head of Marketing) will provide a line, we'd like it by EOD Wed 3/2 so we can get legal sign-off.
2) Permissions: Please sign the release permission (DocuSign link below) and send a high-res logo and preferred byline.
3) Timing: 08:00 PST on 3/4 works for Redwood — I just need a hard commit from ClearSky on the sign-off timeline.
4) Assets: screenshots of the integration dashboard would be helpful (high-res PNGs).

I've attached our proposed press timeline to this thread and will coordinate Redwood's quote internally.

Suggested quote (for Lena to review):
"ClearSky's implementation highlights how teams can reduce inference costs while improving latency with the right serving stack — Redwood is proud to be part of that journey."

"Both companies adhere to industry-standard data retention and access controls; no customer data is shared as part of this announcement."

Evan — can you confirm Lena is comfortable with the edited quote?
